manual.fluid_outlet.line1: And Now The Floodgates Will Open
manual.fluid_outlet.line2: {0}Fluid Outlets are open grates that act as endpoints for pipe systems where fluids can flow out into the world.{1}
manual.fluid_outlet.line3: Fluid can only be filled up to the level of the outlet's sides, and once that level is reached backflow will prevent fluid flow.{0}
manual.fluid_outlet.line4: The sides of the outlet can be changes between input, output, or closed with the Engineer's Hammer.{0}
manual.fluid_outlet.line5: Redstone signals will prevent fluid from flowing into the Fluid Outlet and thus the world.
